1.label: HA-MAI error equals 10 log base 10 of the stabilized mirror-to-error energy ratio

2.label: Cosine and sine basis functions at nominal period H

3.label: Multiply the target by each cosine and sine basis; T is an N by K real template matrix
3.tex: \begin{aligned} T_{m,\cos}[n] &= x[n]\,\cos\!\left(\frac{2\pi mn}{H}\right), \\[0.35em] T_{m,\sin}[n] &= x[n]\,\sin\!\left(\frac{2\pi mn}{H}\right), \\[0.35em] T &\in \mathbb{R}^{N\times K}. \end{aligned}

4.label: G equals T transpose T; rhs equals T transpose e; scale equals trace G over K; alpha equals lambda times max of scale and epsilon; solve for c
4.tex: \begin{aligned} G &= T^{\mathsf T}T, \\[0.15em] \mathrm{rhs} &= T^{\mathsf T}e, \\[0.15em] \mathrm{scale} &= \frac{\operatorname{trace}(G)}{K}, \\[0.15em] \alpha &= \lambda\,\max(\mathrm{scale},\epsilon), \\[0.15em] c &= \operatorname{solve}(G+\alpha I,\,\mathrm{rhs}). \end{aligned}

5.label: Reconstructed mirror error equals T c; mirror energy is its squared L2 norm; error energy is the squared L2 norm of e
5.tex: \begin{aligned} \widehat e_{\mathrm{mirror}} &= Tc, \\[0.35em] E_{\mathrm{mirror}} &= \bigl\lVert\widehat e_{\mathrm{mirror}}\bigr\rVert_2^2, \\[0.35em] E_{\mathrm{error}} &= \lVert e\rVert_2^2. \end{aligned}

6.label: HA-MAI error is bounded below by 10 log base 10 of epsilon over error energy plus epsilon, and above by zero

7.label: Corpus score is the arithmetic mean of valid per-record dB scores

8.label: Domain macro score is the equal-weight mean of corpus scores
